integrity.computation: Exact rational finite corroboration provided as standalone code; no finite enumeration is used as a universal proof.
integrity.proof: Self-contained all-length exact inequality from the minimum-pairwise-gap identity, plus direct finite attaining witnesses.
integrity.source_date_basis: Zenodo describes the 2015 conference publication as published 2015-08-31; earlier generic MAD sources include a December 1993 journal issue without a day printed, and Hampel 1974 mentioned there. The anchor describes the precisely dated moving-Hampel lead rather than a historical first for MAD.

scientific_limitations: Real finite nonwrapping full three-point windows; strictly positive fixed input and output variation-edge weights. Unscaled MAD, with calibration covered only by scalar multiplication. Longer windows, other boundary conventions and weighted observation replication are not treated. First-public-date records the precisely dated 2015 local-Hampel research lead, not the original historical invention of MAD, which was in use well before 2015.
title: Sharp weighted path-variation sensitivity of three-point moving median absolute deviation
